verified_facts.text: The resort is built around the 400-year-old winery at the heart of the property and resembles a traditional fortified Greek village.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by and built around the 400-year-old winery that dominates the heart of the property, the resort resembles a traditional fortified Greek village

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on a more than 500-year-old vineyard overlooking Megalohori and was built in 1993.

verified_facts.text: Antonis Elliopoulos, son of a notable shipping family, developed the family's summer estate into the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Antonis Elliopoulos, the son of a notable shipping family, had the idea of developing the family’s summer estate into an innovative first-class resort

verified_facts.text: Architect Mary Kavagia and interior designers Yiannis Tseklenis and Aggelos Aggelopoulos created the resort as a traditional fortified Greek village.

verified_facts.text: The name Vedema is the Venetian translation for 'harvest'.
verified_facts.excerpt: its name, Vedema, is the direct Venetian translation for 'harvest.'

verified_facts.text: The vineyards around the hotel produce their own vintage, which guests can taste in the Canava Wine Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Even today, the vineyards that surround the hotel are nurtured to produce their own special vintage, available for guests to taste in the Canava Wine Bar.

verified_facts.text: The sunset wine ceremony in the Canava Wine Bar is a tasting of 6 indigenous wines with Greek cheeses and crackers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The unforgettable tasting of 6 exquisite indigenous wines with an excellent variety of Greek cheeses and crackers

verified_facts.text: All suites and villas have their own terraces, and many have jacuzzis or private pools.

verified_facts.text: In all rooms, wooden doors open to a private terrace or patio overlooking the resort gardens.
